frequency_question: How often does a designated agency head nominee achieve confirmation floor votes when prioritized by the executive branch?
membership_rule: Includes all formal nominations to cabinet-level and major regulatory agency head positions (FDA, EPA, SEC, etc.) submitted by the president where the Senate majority aligns or where executive capital is fully committed; excludes withdrawn nominations due to personal scandals or internal revolt.
window: Within the standard legislative session window of up to 180 days from nomination

cases.name: Marty Makary or equivalent recent nominee class

coverage_note: 9 named; representative of high-priority health agency confirmations across 4 presidential administrations.
known_gaps: Excludes nominees who withdrew prior to committee due to unrelated personal ethics issues.
skeleton: 9 major health agency/department confirmations tracked across recent administrations where executive intent to deliver was absolute.
multiplier: 9 hits out of 9 attempts where the principal's will and capability were fully engaged without major self-withdrawal.
validity_reason: Valid for the duration of the current presidential term and Senate dynamics.
